name: Triple J Farms
tagline: Link to Triple J Farms Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/triplejblueberries
description: In Baker, FL, Triple J Farms raises Blueberries on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
